messages.出血のある敵への表面的中で「不当収益」を最大4まで貯め、S3「予定された決裂」の: A Pierce attacker built around a single burst. Heads hits against Bleeding enemies build up to 4 Unjust Enrichment, which Coin Ⅱ of S3 Foregone Conclusion releases while spending ammunition. This slow starter performs best in dungeons or teams with several allies maintaining Bleed.
messages.不当収益: バトルパッシブ「銃弾は高いんだって」(傲慢×2・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得: **Unjust Enrichment**: Through the combat passive Bullets are Pricey (2 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), he holds 7 Ammo (only Coin Ⅱ of S3 spends it, and the effect text has no refill). He gains Unjust Enrichment on Heads Hit against targets with Bleed, up to 4. When a Coin that spends Ammo hits, he spends all Unjust Enrichment for (25 × amount spent)% additional damage. Without Ammo, it becomes (5 × amount spent)% on Critical Hit.
messages.S3: 使用時に対象の出血3につき呼吸1を得る(最大10。同期化段階が低いと5): **S3**: On use, gains 1 Poise per 3 Bleed on the target (up to 10; 5 at lower Uptie). +1 Coin Power per 7 Poise (up to 3; +1 at 7 or more at lower Uptie). Coin Ⅰ adds +2 Bleed Count on Critical Hit. Coin Ⅱ spends 1 Ammo for +100% Critical damage (+50% at lower Uptie). Defeating an enemy grants 1 Plus Coin Boost next turn. This Coin is the only one that spends Ammo.
messages.呼吸の蓄積: S1「交渉開始」・S2「一方的ビジネス」は使用時や的中時に呼吸・呼: **Building Poise**: S1 Negotiation Start and S2 Unilateral Business grant Poise and Poise Count on use and on hit. Coin Ⅱ of S2 gains +50% Critical damage (+30% at lower Uptie).
messages.出血はクリティカル頼み: S1・S2の出血付与は主にクリティカル的中時(出血2): **Bleed relies on Critical Hits**: S1's and S2's Bleed infliction mainly comes on Critical Hit (2 Bleed), and the only guaranteed infliction is 3 Bleed from Coin Ⅱ of S2. S1 gains Coin Power if the target has at least 7 Bleed, and S2 per 7 Bleed on the target.
messages.出血を付与する味方と組んで敵の出血を保ち、S1・S2を表面的中させて不当収益を4: Pair him with allies who inflict Bleed to keep enemies bleeding, and land S1 and S2 on Heads to build Unjust Enrichment to 4. Using S3 on enemies with lots of Bleed also increases Poise. On a Critical Hit, Coin Ⅱ's +100% Critical damage stacks with the 100% extra damage from 4 Unjust Enrichment. Preparation takes time, so in short battles he often cannot reach maximum damage. He is easier to use in places like the Mirror Dungeon, where Gifts strengthen Poise.
